description: This file defines the LivenessTestGrain class, which implements the ILivenessTestGrain interface. It manages grain lifecycle events, timers, and provides methods to get and set labels, retrieve unique identifiers, and obtain grain references within an Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: LivenessTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class used for testing liveness, managing lifecycle, timers, and providing identifiers.

methods.name: LivenessTestGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain with a logger.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, checks primary key, initializes unique ID and label, logs activation.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the current label of the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a new label for the grain and logs the change.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer that triggers TimerTick every 10 seconds.

methods.name: TimerTick
methods.description: Method called periodically by the timer, logs a tick.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain instance.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique GUID assigned to this grain instance.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to this grain as ILivenessTestGrain.
